# Cover letter builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/cover-letter/

Assemble an editable cover letter from your own application details. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter a role, organization, experience paragraph and contact information to draft a printable letter.

## Limits and checks

This is a structured template, not an AI fact generator. Replace example text with accurate experience and proofread before sending.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
